I told Ilse to send the truck to Gate 20 and posted that as a reply to her message in our DM. Gate 20 comes from what she told me in that same DM on Oct 14: her Tamsin Cold Chain pickups for the Osprey project use Gate 20 from now on.

I didn't find anything newer that changes it. #north-team has nothing on Tamsin pickups, and there are no Tamsin account files. That Gate 20 note only covers Osprey pickups, so I asked her to tell me if Thursday's pickup is for something else. I have no gate on file for any other Tamsin pickup.

Because the gate came from her DM, it stayed in that DM and wasn't shared anywhere else.
